1112: static bool do_gc(kv_sec_info_t sector, void *arg1, void *arg2)
1113: {
1114:     struct fdb_kv kv;
1115:     struct gc_cb_args *gc = (struct gc_cb_args *)arg1;
1116:     fdb_kvdb_t db = gc->db;
1117:     uint32_t last_gc_sec_addr = 0;
1118: 
1119:     if (sector->check_ok && (sector->status.dirty == FDB_SECTOR_DIRTY_TRUE || sector->status.dirty == FDB_SECTOR_DIRTY_GC)) {
1120:         uint8_t status_table[FDB_DIRTY_STATUS_TABLE_SIZE];
1121:         /* change the sector status to GC */
1122:         _fdb_write_status((fdb_db_t)db, sector->addr + SECTOR_DIRTY_OFFSET, status_table, FDB_SECTOR_DIRTY_STATUS_NUM, FDB_SECTOR_DIRTY_GC, true);
1123:         /* search all KV */
1124:         kv.addr.start = sector->addr + SECTOR_HDR_DATA_SIZE;
1125:         do {
1126:             read_kv(db, &kv);
1127:             if (kv.crc_is_ok && (kv.status == FDB_KV_WRITE || kv.status == FDB_KV_PRE_DELETE)) {
1128:                 /* move the KV to new space */
1129:                 if (move_kv(db, &kv) != FDB_NO_ERR) {
1130:                     FDB_INFO("Error: Moved the KV (%.*s) for GC failed.\n", kv.name_len, kv.name);
1131:                 }
1132:             } else {
1133:                 FDB_DEBUG("KV (%.*s) is garbage NOT need move, collect it.\n", kv.name_len, kv.name);
1134:             }
1135:         } while ((kv.addr.start = get_next_kv_addr(db, sector, &kv)) != FAILED_ADDR);
1136:         format_sector(db, sector->addr, SECTOR_NOT_COMBINED);
1137:         last_gc_sec_addr = gc->last_gc_sec_addr;
1138:         gc->last_gc_sec_addr = sector->addr;
1139:         /* update oldest_addr for next GC sector format */
1140:         db_oldest_addr(db) = get_next_sector_addr(db, sector, 0);
1141:         FDB_DEBUG("Collect a sector @0x%08" PRIX32 "\n", sector->addr);
1142:         /* the collect new space is in last GC sector */
1143:         struct kvdb_sec_info last_gc_sector;
1144:         if (read_sector_info(db, last_gc_sec_addr, &last_gc_sector, true) == FDB_NO_ERR) {

1844:     itr->iterated_obj_bytes = 0;

1852: /**
1853:  * The KV database iterator.
1854:  *
1855:  * @param db database object
1856:  * @param itr the iterator structure
1857:  *
1858:  * @return false if iteration is ended, true if iteration is not ended.
1859:  */
1860: bool fdb_kv_iterate(fdb_kvdb_t db, fdb_kv_iterator_t itr)
1861: {
1862:     struct kvdb_sec_info sector;
1863:     fdb_kv_t kv = &(itr->curr_kv);
1864: 
1865:     do {
1866:         if (read_sector_info(db, itr->sector_addr, &sector, false) == FDB_NO_ERR) {
1867:             if (sector.status.store == FDB_SECTOR_STORE_USING || sector.status.store == FDB_SECTOR_STORE_FULL) {
1868:                 if (kv->addr.start == 0) {
1869:                     kv->addr.start = sector.addr + SECTOR_HDR_DATA_SIZE;
1870:                 } else if ((kv->addr.start = get_next_kv_addr(db, &sector, kv)) == FAILED_ADDR) {
1871:                     kv->addr.start = 0;
1872:                     itr->traversed_len += db_sec_size(db);
1873:                     continue;
1874:                 }
1875:                 do {
1876:                     read_kv(db, kv);
1877:                     if (kv->status == FDB_KV_WRITE && kv->crc_is_ok == true) {
1878:                         /* We got a valid kv here. */
1879:                         /* If iterator statistics is needed */
1880:                         itr->iterated_cnt++;
1881:                         itr->iterated_obj_bytes += kv->len;
1882:                         itr->iterated_value_bytes += kv->value_len;
1883:                         return true;
1884:                     }
1885:                 } while ((kv->addr.start = get_next_kv_addr(db, &sector, kv)) != FAILED_ADDR);
1886:             }
1887:         }
1888:         /** Set kv->addr.start to 0 when we get into a new sector so that if we successfully get the next sector info,
1889:          *  the kv->addr.start is set to the new sector.addr + SECTOR_HDR_DATA_SIZE.
1890:          */
1891:         kv->addr.start = 0;
1892:         itr->traversed_len += db_sec_size(db);
1893:     } while ((itr->sector_addr = get_next_sector_addr(db, &sector, itr->traversed_len)) != FAILED_ADDR);
1894:     /* Finally we have iterated all the KVs. */
1895:     return false;
1896: }

1898: /**
1899:  * The database inergrity check
1900:  *
1901:  * @param db database object
1902:  *
1903:  * @return result, FDB_NO_ERR: check OK
1904:  */
1905: fdb_err_t fdb_kvdb_check(fdb_kvdb_t db)
1906: {
1907:     fdb_err_t result = FDB_NO_ERR;
1908:     uint32_t sec_addr, traversed_len = 0;
1909:     struct kvdb_sec_info sector;
1910:     struct fdb_kv kv;
1911: 
1912:     if (!db_init_ok(db)) {
1913:         FDB_INFO("Error: KV (%s) isn't initialize OK.\n", db_name(db));
1914:         return FDB_INIT_FAILED;
1915:     }
1916: 
1917:     /* lock the KV cache */
1918:     db_lock(db);
1919: 
1920:     sec_addr = db_oldest_addr(db);
1921:     /* search all sectors */
1922:     do {
1923:         traversed_len += db_sec_size(db);
1924:         result = read_sector_info(db, sec_addr, &sector, false);
1925:         if (result == FDB_NO_ERR)
1926:         {
1927:             /* sector has KV */
1928:             if (sector.status.store == FDB_SECTOR_STORE_USING || sector.status.store == FDB_SECTOR_STORE_FULL) {
1929:                 kv.addr.start = sector.addr + SECTOR_HDR_DATA_SIZE;
1930:                 /* search all KV */
1931:                 do {
1932:                     result = read_kv(db, &kv);
1933:                 } while ((kv.addr.start = get_next_kv_addr(db, &sector, &kv)) != FAILED_ADDR && result == FDB_NO_ERR);
1934:             }
1935:         }
1936:     } while ((sec_addr = get_next_sector_addr(db, &sector, traversed_len)) != FAILED_ADDR && result == FDB_NO_ERR);
1937: 
1938:     /* unlock the KV cache */
1939:     db_unlock(db);
1940: 
1941:     return result;
1942: }

1944: #endif /* defined(FDB_USING_KVDB) */

217: 
218:     if (pre_tsl->addr.index >= (sector->addr + SECTOR_HDR_DATA_SIZE + LOG_IDX_DATA_SIZE)) {
219:         addr = pre_tsl->addr.index - LOG_IDX_DATA_SIZE;
220:     } else {
221:         return FAILED_ADDR;
222:     }
223: 
224:     return addr;
225: }

227: static uint32_t get_last_sector_addr(fdb_tsdb_t db, tsdb_sec_info_t pre_sec, uint32_t traversed_len)
228: {
229:     if (traversed_len + db_sec_size(db) <= db_max_size(db)) {
230:         if (pre_sec->addr >= db_sec_size(db)) {
231:             /* the next sector is previous sector */
232:             return pre_sec->addr - db_sec_size(db);
233:         } else {
234:             /* the next sector is the last sector */
235:             return db_max_size(db) - db_sec_size(db);
236:         }
237:     } else {
238:         return FAILED_ADDR;
239:     }
240: }

242: static fdb_err_t read_sector_info(fdb_tsdb_t db, uint32_t addr, tsdb_sec_info_t sector, bool traversal)
243: {
244:     fdb_err_t result = FDB_NO_ERR;
245:     struct sector_hdr_data sec_hdr;
246: 
247:     FDB_ASSERT(sector);
248: 
249:     /* read sector header raw data */
250:     _fdb_flash_read((fdb_db_t)db, addr, (uint32_t *)&sec_hdr, sizeof(struct sector_hdr_data));
251: 
252:     sector->addr = addr;
253:     memcpy(&sector->magic, sec_hdr.magic, sizeof(uint32_t));
254: 
255:     /* check magic word */
256:     if (sector->magic != SECTOR_MAGIC_WORD) {
257:         sector->check_ok = false;
258:         return FDB_INIT_FAILED;
259:     }
260:     sector->check_ok = true;
261:     sector->status = (fdb_sector_store_status_t) _fdb_get_status(sec_hdr.status, FDB_SECTOR_STORE_STATUS_NUM);
262:     memcpy(&sector->start_time, sec_hdr.start_time, sizeof(fdb_time_t));
263:     sector->end_info_stat[0] = (fdb_tsl_status_t) _fdb_get_status(sec_hdr.end_info[0].status, FDB_TSL_STATUS_NUM);
264:     sector->end_info_stat[1] = (fdb_tsl_status_t) _fdb_get_status(sec_hdr.end_info[1].status, FDB_TSL_STATUS_NUM);
265:     if (sector->end_info_stat[0] == FDB_TSL_WRITE) {
266:         memcpy(&sector->end_time, sec_hdr.end_info[0].time, sizeof(fdb_time_t));
267:         memcpy(&sector->end_idx, sec_hdr.end_info[0].index, sizeof(uint32_t));
268:     } else if (sector->end_info_stat[1] == FDB_TSL_WRITE) {
269:         memcpy(&sector->end_time, sec_hdr.end_info[1].time, sizeof(fdb_time_t));
270:         memcpy(&sector->end_idx, sec_hdr.end_info[1].index, sizeof(uint32_t));
271:     } else if (sector->end_info_stat[0] == FDB_TSL_PRE_WRITE && sector->end_info_stat[1] == FDB_TSL_PRE_WRITE) {
272:         //TODO There is no valid end node info on this sector, need impl fast query this sector by fdb_tsl_iter_by_time
273:         FDB_ASSERT(0);
274:     }
275:     /* traversal all TSL and calculate the remain space size */
276:     sector->empty_idx = sector->addr + SECTOR_HDR_DATA_SIZE;
277:     sector->empty_data = sector->addr + db_sec_size(db);
278:     /* the TSL's data is saved from sector bottom, and the TSL's index saved from the sector top */
279:     sector->remain = sector->empty_data - sector->empty_idx;
280:     if (sector->status == FDB_SECTOR_STORE_USING && traversal) {
281:         struct fdb_tsl tsl;
282: 
283:         tsl.addr.index = sector->empty_idx;
284:         while (read_tsl(db, &tsl) == FDB_NO_ERR) {
285:             if (tsl.status == FDB_TSL_UNUSED) {
286:                 break;
287:             }
288:             if (tsl.status != FDB_TSL_PRE_WRITE) {
289:                 sector->end_time = tsl.time;
290:             }
291:             sector->end_idx = tsl.addr.index;
292:             sector->empty_idx += LOG_IDX_DATA_SIZE;
293:             sector->empty_data -= FDB_WG_ALIGN(tsl.log_len);
294:             tsl.addr.index += LOG_IDX_DATA_SIZE;
295:             if (sector->remain > LOG_IDX_DATA_SIZE + FDB_WG_ALIGN(tsl.log_len)) {
296:                 sector->remain -= (LOG_IDX_DATA_SIZE + FDB_WG_ALIGN(tsl.log_len));
297:             } else {
298:                 FDB_INFO("Error: this TSL (0x%08" PRIX32 ") size (%" PRIu32 ") is out of bound.\n", tsl.addr.index, tsl.log_len);
299:                 sector->remain = 0;
300:                 result = FDB_READ_ERR;
301:                 break;
302:             }
303:         }
304:     }
305: 
306:     return result;
307: }

309: static fdb_err_t format_sector(fdb_tsdb_t db, uint32_t addr)
310: {
311:     fdb_err_t result = FDB_NO_ERR;
312:     struct sector_hdr_data sec_hdr;
313:     uint32_t magic = SECTOR_MAGIC_WORD;
314: 
315:     FDB_ASSERT(addr % db_sec_size(db) == 0);
316: 
317:     result = _fdb_flash_erase((fdb_db_t)db, addr, db_sec_size(db));
318:     if (result == FDB_NO_ERR) {
319:         _FDB_WRITE_STATUS(db, addr, sec_hdr.status, FDB_SECTOR_STORE_STATUS_NUM, FDB_SECTOR_STORE_EMPTY, true);
320:         /* set the magic */
321:         memset(sec_hdr.magic, FDB_BYTE_ERASED, TSL_UINT32_ALIGN_SIZE);
322:         memcpy(sec_hdr.magic, &magic, sizeof(uint32_t));
323:         FLASH_WRITE(db, addr + SECTOR_MAGIC_OFFSET, &sec_hdr.magic, TSL_UINT32_ALIGN_SIZE, true);
324:     }
325: 
326:     return result;
327: }

329: static void sector_iterator(fdb_tsdb_t db, tsdb_sec_info_t sector, fdb_sector_store_status_t status, void *arg1,
330:         void *arg2, bool (*callback)(tsdb_sec_info_t sector, void *arg1, void *arg2), bool traversal)
331: {
332:     uint32_t sec_addr = sector->addr, traversed_len = 0;
333: 
334:     /* search all sectors */
335:     do {
336:         read_sector_info(db, sec_addr, sector, false);
337:         if (status == FDB_SECTOR_STORE_UNUSED || status == sector->status) {
338:             if (traversal) {
339:                 read_sector_info(db, sec_addr, sector, true);
340:             }
341:             /* iterator is interrupted when callback return true */
342:             if (callback && callback(sector, arg1, arg2)) {
343:                 return;
344:             }
345:         }
346:         traversed_len += db_sec_size(db);
347:     } while ((sec_addr = get_next_sector_addr(db, sector, traversed_len)) != FAILED_ADDR);
348: }

350: static fdb_err_t write_tsl(fdb_tsdb_t db, fdb_blob_t blob, fdb_time_t time)
351: {
352:     fdb_err_t result = FDB_NO_ERR;
353:     struct log_idx_data idx;
354:     uint32_t idx_addr = db->cur_sec.empty_idx;
355:     uint32_t log_addr = db->cur_sec.empty_data - FDB_WG_ALIGN(blob->size);
356: 
357: #ifndef FDB_TSDB_FIXED_BLOB_SIZE
358:     // variable-size blobs must store address and size in flash
359:     idx.log_addr = log_addr;
360:     idx.log_len = blob->size;
361: #endif
362:     idx.time = time;
363: 
364:     /* write the status will by write granularity */
365:     _FDB_WRITE_STATUS(db, idx_addr, idx.status_table, FDB_TSL_STATUS_NUM, FDB_TSL_PRE_WRITE, false);
366:     /* write other index info */
367:     FLASH_WRITE(db, idx_addr + LOG_IDX_TS_OFFSET, &idx.time,  sizeof(struct log_idx_data) - LOG_IDX_TS_OFFSET, false);
368:     /* write blob data */
369:     result = _fdb_flash_write_align((fdb_db_t)db, log_addr, blob->buf, blob->size);
370:     if (result != FDB_NO_ERR){
371:         return result;
372:     }
373:     /* write the status will by write granularity */
374:     _FDB_WRITE_STATUS(db, idx_addr, idx.status_table, FDB_TSL_STATUS_NUM, FDB_TSL_WRITE, true);
375: 
376:     return result;
377: }

379: static fdb_err_t update_sec_status(fdb_tsdb_t db, tsdb_sec_info_t sector, fdb_blob_t blob, fdb_time_t cur_time)
380: {
381:     fdb_err_t result = FDB_NO_ERR;
382:     uint8_t status[FDB_STORE_STATUS_TABLE_SIZE];
383:     uint8_t time[TSL_TIME_ALIGN_SIZE];
384:     uint8_t index[TSL_UINT32_ALIGN_SIZE];
385: 
386:     if (sector->status == FDB_SECTOR_STORE_USING && sector->remain < LOG_IDX_DATA_SIZE + FDB_WG_ALIGN(blob->size)) {
387:         uint8_t end_status[TSL_STATUS_TABLE_SIZE];
388:         uint32_t end_index_temp = sector->empty_idx - LOG_IDX_DATA_SIZE, new_sec_addr, cur_sec_addr = sector->addr;
389: 
390:         memset(index, FDB_BYTE_ERASED, TSL_UINT32_ALIGN_SIZE);
391:         memcpy(index, &end_index_temp, sizeof(uint32_t));
392: 
393:         memset(time, FDB_BYTE_ERASED, TSL_TIME_ALIGN_SIZE);
394:         memcpy(time, &db->last_time, sizeof(fdb_time_t));
395: 
396:         /* save the end node index and timestamp */
397:         if (sector->end_info_stat[0] == FDB_TSL_UNUSED) {
398:             _FDB_WRITE_STATUS(db, cur_sec_addr + SECTOR_END0_STATUS_OFFSET, end_status, FDB_TSL_STATUS_NUM, FDB_TSL_PRE_WRITE, false);
399:             FLASH_WRITE(db, cur_sec_addr + SECTOR_END0_TIME_OFFSET, time, TSL_TIME_ALIGN_SIZE, false);
400:             FLASH_WRITE(db, cur_sec_addr + SECTOR_END0_IDX_OFFSET, index, TSL_UINT32_ALIGN_SIZE, false);
401:             _FDB_WRITE_STATUS(db, cur_sec_addr + SECTOR_END0_STATUS_OFFSET, end_status, FDB_TSL_STATUS_NUM, FDB_TSL_WRITE, true);
402:         } else if (sector->end_info_stat[1] == FDB_TSL_UNUSED) {
403:             _FDB_WRITE_STATUS(db, cur_sec_addr + SECTOR_END1_STATUS_OFFSET, end_status, FDB_TSL_STATUS_NUM, FDB_TSL_PRE_WRITE, false);
404:             FLASH_WRITE(db, cur_sec_addr + SECTOR_END1_TIME_OFFSET, time, TSL_TIME_ALIGN_SIZE, false);
405:             FLASH_WRITE(db, cur_sec_addr + SECTOR_END1_IDX_OFFSET, index, TSL_UINT32_ALIGN_SIZE, false);
406:             _FDB_WRITE_STATUS(db, cur_sec_addr + SECTOR_END1_STATUS_OFFSET, end_status, FDB_TSL_STATUS_NUM, FDB_TSL_WRITE, true);
407:         }
408:         /* change current sector to full */
409:         _FDB_WRITE_STATUS(db, cur_sec_addr, status, FDB_SECTOR_STORE_STATUS_NUM, FDB_SECTOR_STORE_FULL, true);
410:         sector->status = FDB_SECTOR_STORE_FULL;
411:         /* calculate next sector address */
412:         if (sector->addr + db_sec_size(db) < db_max_size(db)) {
413:             new_sec_addr = sector->addr + db_sec_size(db);
414:         }
415:         else if (db->rollover) {
416:             new_sec_addr = 0;
417:         } else {
418:             /* not rollover */
419:             return FDB_SAVED_FULL;
420:         }
421:         read_sector_info(db, new_sec_addr, &db->cur_sec, false);
422:         if (sector->status != FDB_SECTOR_STORE_EMPTY) {
423:             /* calculate the oldest sector address */
424:             if (new_sec_addr + db_sec_size(db) < db_max_size(db)) {
425:                 db_oldest_addr(db) = new_sec_addr + db_sec_size(db);
426:             } else {
427:                 db_oldest_addr(db) = 0;
428:             }
429:             format_sector(db, new_sec_addr);
430:             read_sector_info(db, new_sec_addr, &db->cur_sec, false);
431:         }
432:     } else if (sector->status == FDB_SECTOR_STORE_FULL) {
433:         /* database full */
434:         return FDB_SAVED_FULL;
435:     }
436: 
437:     if (sector->status == FDB_SECTOR_STORE_EMPTY) {
438:         /* change the sector to using */
439:         sector->status = FDB_SECTOR_STORE_USING;
440:         sector->start_time = cur_time;
441:         _FDB_WRITE_STATUS(db, sector->addr, status, FDB_SECTOR_STORE_STATUS_NUM, FDB_SECTOR_STORE_USING, true);
442:         /* save the start timestamp */
443:         memset(time, FDB_BYTE_ERASED, TSL_TIME_ALIGN_SIZE);
444:         memcpy(time, &cur_time, sizeof(fdb_time_t));
445:         FLASH_WRITE(db, sector->addr + SECTOR_START_TIME_OFFSET, time, TSL_TIME_ALIGN_SIZE, true);
446:     }
447: 
448:     return result;
449: }

451: static fdb_err_t tsl_append(fdb_tsdb_t db, fdb_blob_t blob, fdb_time_t *timestamp)
452: {
453:     fdb_err_t result = FDB_NO_ERR;
454:     fdb_time_t cur_time = timestamp == NULL ? db->get_time() : *timestamp;
455: 
456: #ifdef FDB_TSDB_FIXED_BLOB_SIZE
457:     if (blob->size != FDB_TSDB_FIXED_BLOB_SIZE) {
458:         FDB_INFO("Error: blob size (%zu) must equal FDB_TSDB_FIXED_BLOB_SIZE (%d)\n", blob->size, FDB_TSDB_FIXED_BLOB_SIZE);
459:         return FDB_WRITE_ERR;
460:     }
461: #else
462:     /* check the append length, MUST less than the db->max_len */
463:     if(blob->size > db->max_len)
464:     {
465:         FDB_INFO("Warning: append length (%" PRIdMAX ") is more than the db->max_len (%" PRIdMAX "). This tsl will be dropped.\n",
466:                 (intmax_t)blob->size, (intmax_t)(db->max_len));
467:         return FDB_WRITE_ERR;
468:     }
469: #endif
470: 
471:     /* check the current timestamp, MUST more than the last save timestamp */
472:     if (cur_time <= db->last_time) {
473:         FDB_INFO("Warning: current timestamp (%" PRIdMAX ") is less than or equal to the last save timestamp (%" PRIdMAX "). This tsl will be dropped.\n",
474:                 (intmax_t )cur_time, (intmax_t )(db->last_time));
475:         return FDB_WRITE_ERR;
476:     }
477: 
478:     result = update_sec_status(db, &db->cur_sec, blob, cur_time);
479:     if (result != FDB_NO_ERR) {
480:         FDB_INFO("Error: update the sector status failed (%d)", result);
481:         return result;
482:     }
483:     /* write the TSL node */
484:     result = write_tsl(db, blob, cur_time);
485:     if (result != FDB_NO_ERR) {
486:         FDB_INFO("Error: write tsl failed (%d)", result);
487:         return result;
488:     }
489: 
490:     /* recalculate the current using sector info */
491:     db->cur_sec.end_idx = db->cur_sec.empty_idx;
492:     db->cur_sec.end_time = cur_time;
493:     db->cur_sec.empty_idx += LOG_IDX_DATA_SIZE;
494:     db->cur_sec.empty_data -= FDB_WG_ALIGN(blob->size);
495:     db->cur_sec.remain -= LOG_IDX_DATA_SIZE + FDB_WG_ALIGN(blob->size);
496:     db->last_time = cur_time;
497: 
498:     return result;
499: }

549: /**
550:  * The TSDB iterator for each TSL.
551:  *
552:  * @param db database object
553:  * @param cb callback
554:  * @param arg callback argument
555:  */
556: void fdb_tsl_iter(fdb_tsdb_t db, fdb_tsl_cb cb, void *arg)
557: {
558:     struct tsdb_sec_info sector;
559:     uint32_t sec_addr, traversed_len = 0;
560:     struct fdb_tsl tsl;
561: 
562:     if (!db_init_ok(db)) {
563:         FDB_INFO("Error: TSL (%s) isn't initialize OK.\n", db_name(db));
564:     }
565: 
566:     if (cb == NULL) {
567:         return;
568:     }
569: 
570:     sec_addr = db_oldest_addr(db);
571: 	db_lock(db);
572:     /* search all sectors */
573:     do {
574:         traversed_len += db_sec_size(db);
575:         if (read_sector_info(db, sec_addr, &sector, false) != FDB_NO_ERR) {
576:             continue;
577:         }
578:         /* sector has TSL */
579:         if (sector.status == FDB_SECTOR_STORE_USING || sector.status == FDB_SECTOR_STORE_FULL) {
580:             if (sector.status == FDB_SECTOR_STORE_USING) {
581:                 /* copy the current using sector status  */
582:                 sector = db->cur_sec;
583:             }
584:             tsl.addr.index = sector.addr + SECTOR_HDR_DATA_SIZE;
585:             /* search all TSL */
586:             do {
587:                 read_tsl(db, &tsl);
588:                 /* iterator is interrupted when callback return true */
589:                 if (cb(&tsl, arg)) {
590:                     db_unlock(db);
591:                     return;
592:                 }
593:             } while ((tsl.addr.index = get_next_tsl_addr(&sector, &tsl)) != FAILED_ADDR);
594:         }
595:     } while ((sec_addr = get_next_sector_addr(db, &sector, traversed_len)) != FAILED_ADDR);
596:     db_unlock(db);
597: }

599: /**
600:  * The TSDB iterator for each TSL.
601:  *
602:  * @param db database object
603:  * @param cb callback
604:  * @param arg callback argument
605:  */
606: void fdb_tsl_iter_reverse(fdb_tsdb_t db, fdb_tsl_cb cb, void *cb_arg)
607: {
608:     struct tsdb_sec_info sector;
609:     uint32_t sec_addr, traversed_len = 0;
610:     struct fdb_tsl tsl;
611: 
612:     if (!db_init_ok(db)) {
613:         FDB_INFO("Error: TSL (%s) isn't initialize OK.\n", db_name(db));
614:     }
615: 
616:     if (cb == NULL) {
617:         return;
618:     }
619: 
620:     sec_addr = db->cur_sec.addr;
621:     db_lock(db);
622:     /* search all sectors */
623:     do {
624:         traversed_len += db_sec_size(db);
625:         if (read_sector_info(db, sec_addr, &sector, false) != FDB_NO_ERR) {
626:             continue;
627:         }
628:         /* sector has TSL */
629:         if (sector.status == FDB_SECTOR_STORE_USING || sector.status == FDB_SECTOR_STORE_FULL) {
630:             if (sector.status == FDB_SECTOR_STORE_USING) {
631:                 /* copy the current using sector status  */
632:                 sector = db->cur_sec;
633:             }
634:             tsl.addr.index = sector.end_idx;
635:             /* search all TSL */
636:             do {
637:                 read_tsl(db, &tsl);
638:                 /* iterator is interrupted when callback return true */
639:                 if (cb(&tsl, cb_arg)) {
640:                     goto __exit;
641:                 }
642:             } while ((tsl.addr.index = get_last_tsl_addr(&sector, &tsl)) != FAILED_ADDR);
643:         } else if (sector.status == FDB_SECTOR_STORE_EMPTY || sector.status == FDB_SECTOR_STORE_UNUSED)
644:             goto __exit;
645:     } while ((sec_addr = get_last_sector_addr(db, &sector, traversed_len)) != FAILED_ADDR);
646: 
647: __exit:
648:     db_unlock(db);
649: }

651: /*
652:  * Found the matched TSL address.
653:  */
654: static int search_start_tsl_addr(fdb_tsdb_t db, int start, int end, fdb_time_t from, fdb_time_t to)
655: {
656:     struct fdb_tsl tsl;
657:     while (true) {
658:         tsl.addr.index = start + FDB_ALIGN((end - start) / 2, LOG_IDX_DATA_SIZE);
659:         read_tsl(db, &tsl);
660:         if (tsl.time < from) {
661:             start = tsl.addr.index + LOG_IDX_DATA_SIZE;
662:         } else if (tsl.time > from) {
663:             end = tsl.addr.index - LOG_IDX_DATA_SIZE;
664:         } else {
665:             return tsl.addr.index;
666:         }
667: 
668:         if (start > end) {
669:             if (from > to) {
670:                 tsl.addr.index = start;
671:                 read_tsl(db, &tsl);
672:                 if (tsl.time > from) {
673:                     start -= LOG_IDX_DATA_SIZE;
674:                 }
675:             }
676:             break;
677:         }
678:     }
679:     return start;
680: }

682: /**
683:  * The TSDB iterator for each TSL by timestamp.
684:  *
685:  * @param db database object
686:  * @param from starting timestamp. It will be a reverse iterator when ending timestamp less than starting timestamp
687:  * @param to ending timestamp
688:  * @param cb callback
689:  * @param arg callback argument
690:  */
691: void fdb_tsl_iter_by_time(fdb_tsdb_t db, fdb_time_t from, fdb_time_t to, fdb_tsl_cb cb, void *cb_arg)
692: {
693:     struct tsdb_sec_info sector;
694:     uint32_t sec_addr, start_addr, traversed_len = 0;
695:     struct fdb_tsl tsl;
696:     bool found_start_tsl = false;
697: 
698:     uint32_t (*get_sector_addr)(fdb_tsdb_t , tsdb_sec_info_t , uint32_t);
699:     uint32_t (*get_tsl_addr)(tsdb_sec_info_t , fdb_tsl_t);
700: 
701:     if (!db_init_ok(db)) {
702:         FDB_INFO("Error: TSL (%s) isn't initialize OK.\n", db_name(db));
703:     }
704: 
705:     if(from <= to) {
706:         start_addr = db_oldest_addr(db);
707:         get_sector_addr = get_next_sector_addr;
708:         get_tsl_addr = get_next_tsl_addr;
709:     } else {
710:         start_addr = db->cur_sec.addr;
711:         get_sector_addr = get_last_sector_addr;
712:         get_tsl_addr = get_last_tsl_addr;

1058:         } else {

1063:                 latest_addr = db->cur_sec.addr = db_max_size(db) - db_sec_size(db);

1067:         if (latest_addr + db_sec_size(db) >= db_max_size(db)) {
1068:             /* db->cur_sec is the the bottom of the database */

150:                 {
151:                     LOG_W("cannot remove '%s'", full_path);
152:                     res = -1;
153:                 }
154:             }
155:             else if (dirent->d_type == DT_DIR)
156:             {
157:                 if (dir_delete(full_path) != 0)
158:                 {
159:                     res = -1;
160:                 }
161:             }
162:         }
163:     }
164:     closedir(dir);

168:     {
169:         if (unlink(path) != 0)
170:         {
171:             LOG_W("cannot remove '%s'", path);
172:             res = -1;
173:         }
174:     }
175: 
176:     return res;

359: static int iter_all_kv(fdb_kvdb_t db, struct test_kv *kv_tbl, size_t len)
360: {
361:     struct fdb_kv_iterator iterator;
362:     fdb_kv_t cur_kv;
363:     size_t data_size = 0;
364:     int index = 0;
365:     struct fdb_blob fdb_blob;
366: 
367:     fdb_kv_iterator_init(db, &iterator);
368:     while (fdb_kv_iterate(db, &iterator) == true && index < len)
369:     {
370:         /* get data len */
371:         cur_kv = &(iterator.curr_kv);
372:         data_size = (size_t)cur_kv->value_len;
373: 
374:         strncpy(kv_tbl[index].name, cur_kv->name, 32);
375:         kv_tbl[index].saved_data_size = data_size;
376:         kv_tbl[index].addr = cur_kv->addr.start;
377:         kv_tbl[index].value = (char *)malloc(data_size);
378:         if (kv_tbl[index].value == NULL)
379:             assert(0 && "no memory for value");
380:         /* read data */
381:         fdb_blob_read((fdb_db_t)db, fdb_kv_to_blob(cur_kv, fdb_blob_make(&fdb_blob, kv_tbl[index].value, data_size)));
382:         index++;
383:     }
384: 
385:     return index;
386: }

/// Calculate the CRC32 value of a memory buffer.
/// Identical to C `fdb_calc_crc32`.
pub fn calc_crc32(crc: u32, buf: &[u8]) -> u32 {
    let mut crc = crc ^ !0u32;
    for &byte in buf {
        crc = CRC32_TABLE[(crc as usize ^ byte as usize) & 0xFF] ^ (crc >> 8);
    }
    crc ^ !0u32
}

22:     //   store: FDB_STORE_STATUS_TABLE_SIZE bytes
23:     //   dirty: FDB_DIRTY_STATUS_TABLE_SIZE bytes
24:     //   magic: 4 bytes
25:     //   combined: 4 bytes
26:     //   reserved: 4 bytes
27:     let raw = FDB_STORE_STATUS_TABLE_SIZE + FDB_DIRTY_STATUS_TABLE_SIZE + 4 + 4 + 4;
28:     wg_align(raw)
29: }
30: 
31: /// Compute KV header data size at runtime.
32: fn kv_hdr_data_size() -> usize {
33:     // kv_hdr_data: status_table + magic + len + crc32 + name_len + value_len
34:     let raw = KV_STATUS_TABLE_SIZE + 4 + 4 + 4 + 1 + 4;
35:     wg_align(raw)
36: }
37: 
38: /// Compute FDB_SEC_REMAIN_THRESHOLD = KV_HDR_DATA_SIZE + FDB_KV_NAME_MAX
39: fn sec_remain_threshold() -> usize {
40:     kv_hdr_data_size() + FDB_KV_NAME_MAX
41: }
42: 
43: // Offsets into sector header
44: fn sector_store_offset() -> usize { 0 }
45: fn sector_dirty_offset() -> usize { FDB_STORE_STATUS_TABLE_SIZE }
46: fn sector_magic_offset() -> usize { FDB_STORE_STATUS_TABLE_SIZE + FDB_DIRTY_STATUS_TABLE_SIZE }
47: fn kv_magic_offset() -> usize { KV_STATUS_TABLE_SIZE }
48: fn kv_len_offset() -> usize { KV_STATUS_TABLE_SIZE + 4 }
49: fn kv_name_len_offset() -> usize { KV_STATUS_TABLE_SIZE + 4 + 4 + 4 }
50: 
51: fn sector_num(max_size: u32, sec_size: u32) -> u32 {
52:     max_size / sec_size
53: }

143:     fn update_sector_cache(&mut self, sector: &KvdbSecInfo) {
144:         for i in 0..self.sector_cache.len() {
145:             if self.sector_cache[i].addr == sector.addr {
146:                 if sector.check_ok {
147:                     self.sector_cache[i] = sector.clone();
148:                 } else {
149:                     self.sector_cache[i].addr = FDB_DATA_UNUSED;
150:                 }
151:                 return;
152:             } else if self.sector_cache[i].addr == FDB_DATA_UNUSED {
153:                 // empty slot found
154:             }
155:         }
156:         if sector.check_ok {
157:             for i in 0..self.sector_cache.len() {
158:                 if self.sector_cache[i].addr == FDB_DATA_UNUSED {
159:                     self.sector_cache[i] = sector.clone();
160:                     return;
161:                 }
162:             }
163:         }
164:     }

173:     }

188:     fn update_kv_cache(&mut self, name: &str, addr: u32) {
189:         let name_crc = (calc_crc32(0, name.as_bytes()) >> 16) as u16;
190:         let name_len = name.len();
191: 
192:         if addr != FDB_DATA_UNUSED {
193:             // Update existing
194:             for i in 0..self.kv_cache.len() {
195:                 if self.kv_cache[i].name_crc == name_crc {
196:                     self.kv_cache[i].addr = addr;
197:                     return;
198:                 }
199:             }
200:             // Find empty slot
201:             let mut empty_index = self.kv_cache.len();
202:             let mut min_activity_index = self.kv_cache.len();
203:             let mut min_activity: u16 = 0xFFFF;
204: 
205:             for i in 0..self.kv_cache.len() {
206:                 if self.kv_cache[i].addr == FDB_DATA_UNUSED && empty_index == self.kv_cache.len() {
207:                     empty_index = i;
208:                 } else if self.kv_cache[i].addr != FDB_DATA_UNUSED {
209:                     if self.kv_cache[i].active > 0 {
210:                         self.kv_cache[i].active -= 1;
211:                     }
212:                     if self.kv_cache[i].active < min_activity {
213:                         min_activity_index = i;
214:                         min_activity = self.kv_cache[i].active;
215:                     }
216:                 }
217:             }
218: 
219:             if empty_index < self.kv_cache.len() {
220:                 self.kv_cache[empty_index].addr = addr;
221:                 self.kv_cache[empty_index].name_crc = name_crc;
222:                 self.kv_cache[empty_index].active = self.kv_cache.len() as u16;
223:             } else if min_activity_index < self.kv_cache.len() {
224:                 self.kv_cache[min_activity_index].addr = addr;
225:                 self.kv_cache[min_activity_index].name_crc = name_crc;
226:                 self.kv_cache[min_activity_index].active = self.kv_cache.len() as u16;
227:             }
228:         } else {
229:             // Delete
230:             for i in 0..self.kv_cache.len() {
231:                 if self.kv_cache[i].name_crc == name_crc {
232:                     self.kv_cache[i].addr = FDB_DATA_UNUSED;
233:                     self.kv_cache[i].active = 0;
234:                     return;
235:                 }
236:             }
237:         }
238:     }
239: 
240:     fn get_kv_from_cache(&mut self, name: &str) -> Option<u32> {
241:         let name_crc = (calc_crc32(0, name.as_bytes()) >> 16) as u16;
242:         let name_len = name.len();
243: 
244:         for i in 0..self.kv_cache.len() {
245:             if self.kv_cache[i].addr != FDB_DATA_UNUSED && self.kv_cache[i].name_crc == name_crc {
246:                 // Read the KV name from flash to verify
247:                 let mut saved_name = vec![0u8; FDB_KV_NAME_MAX];
248:                 let kv_hdr_sz = kv_hdr_data_size();
249:                 if self.be().read(self.kv_cache[i].addr + kv_hdr_sz as u32, &mut saved_name).is_ok() {
250:                     if name.as_bytes() == &saved_name[..name_len] {
251:                         let addr = self.kv_cache[i].addr;
252:                         let active = self.kv_cache[i].active;
253:                         self.kv_cache[i].active = if active >= 0xFFFF - self.kv_cache.len() as u16 {
254:                             0xFFFF
255:                         } else {
256:                             active + self.kv_cache.len() as u16
257:                         };
258:                         return Some(addr);
259:                     }
260:                 }
261:             }
262:         }
263:         None
264:     }

266:     /// Find the next KV address by magic word.
267:     fn find_next_kv_addr(&self, start: u32, end: u32) -> u32 {
268:         // Check cache first
269:         let sec_addr = fdb_align_down(start as usize, self.sec_size as usize) as u32;
270:         if let Some(idx) = self.get_sector_from_cache(sec_addr) {
271:             if start == self.sector_cache[idx].empty_kv {
272:                 return FDB_FAILED_ADDR;
273:             }
274:         }
275: 
276:         let mut buf = [0u8; 32];
277:         let start_bak = start;
278:         let mut cur = start;
279: 
280:         while cur < end && cur + 32 < end {
281:             if self.be().read(cur, &mut buf).is_err() {
282:                 return FDB_FAILED_ADDR;
283:             }
284:             for i in 0..(32 - 4) {
285:                 if cur + i as u32 >= end {
286:                     break;
287:                 }
288:                 // Little endian
289:                 let magic = buf[i] as u32
290:                     | ((buf[i + 1] as u32) << 8)
291:                     | ((buf[i + 2] as u32) << 16)
292:                     | ((buf[i + 3] as u32) << 24);
293:                 if magic == KV_MAGIC_WORD {
294:                     let addr = cur + i as u32;
295:                     let kv_addr = if kv_magic_offset() <= addr as usize {
296:                         addr - kv_magic_offset() as u32
297:                     } else {
298:                         continue;
299:                     };
300:                     if kv_addr >= start_bak {
301:                         return kv_addr;
302:                     }
303:                 }
304:             }
305:             cur += (32 - 4) as u32;
306:         }
307: 
308:         FDB_FAILED_ADDR
309:     }
310: 
311:     /// Get next KV address in a sector.
312:     fn get_next_kv_addr(&self, sector: &KvdbSecInfo, pre_kv: &KvInfo) -> u32 {
313:         if sector.store_status == SectorStoreStatus::Empty {
314:             return FDB_FAILED_ADDR;
315:         }
316: 
317:         let sec_hdr_sz = sector_hdr_data_size(self.sec_size) as u32;
318: 
319:         let addr = if pre_kv.addr_start == FDB_FAILED_ADDR {
320:             sector.addr + sec_hdr_sz
321:         } else if pre_kv.addr_start <= sector.addr + self.sec_size {
322:             if pre_kv.crc_is_ok {
323:                 pre_kv.addr_start + pre_kv.len
324:             } else {
325:                 pre_kv.addr_start + wg_align(1) as u32
326:             }
327:         } else {
328:             return FDB_FAILED_ADDR;
329:         };
330: 
331:         if addr == FDB_FAILED_ADDR || addr > sector.addr + self.sec_size || pre_kv.len == 0 {
332:             return FDB_FAILED_ADDR;
333:         }
334: 
335:         self.find_next_kv_addr(addr, sector.addr + self.sec_size - sec_hdr_sz)
336:     }

338:     /// Read a KV from flash.
339:     fn read_kv(&mut self, kv: &mut KvInfo) -> Result<(), FdbErr> {
340:         let kv_hdr_sz = kv_hdr_data_size();
341:         let mut kv_hdr_buf = vec![0u8; kv_hdr_sz];
342:         self.be().read(kv.addr_start, &mut kv_hdr_buf)?;
343: 
344:         // Parse KV header from raw bytes
345:         let kv_status = status::get_status(&kv_hdr_buf[..KV_STATUS_TABLE_SIZE], FDB_KV_STATUS_NUM);
346:         kv.status = match kv_status {
347:             0 => KvStatus::Unused,
348:             1 => KvStatus::PreWrite,
349:             2 => KvStatus::Write,
350:             3 => KvStatus::PreDelete,
351:             4 => KvStatus::Deleted,
352:             5 => KvStatus::ErrHdr,
353:             _ => KvStatus::ErrHdr,
354:         };
355: 
356:         kv.len = u32::from_le_bytes(kv_hdr_buf[kv_len_offset()..kv_len_offset() + 4].try_into().unwrap());
357: 
358:         if kv.len == u32::MAX || kv.len > self.max_size || kv.len < kv_hdr_sz as u32 {
359:             kv.len = kv_hdr_sz as u32;
360:             if kv.status != KvStatus::ErrHdr {
361:                 kv.status = KvStatus::ErrHdr;
362:                 let mut st = vec![0u8; KV_STATUS_TABLE_SIZE];
363:                 let _ = status::write_status(self.be(), kv.addr_start, &mut st, FDB_KV_STATUS_NUM, KvStatus::ErrHdr as usize, true);
364:             }
365:             kv.crc_is_ok = false;
366:             return Err(FdbErr::ReadErr);
367:         }
368: 
369:         let name_len = kv_hdr_buf[kv_name_len_offset()] as usize;
370:         let value_len = u32::from_le_bytes(
371:             kv_hdr_buf[kv_name_len_offset() + 1..kv_name_len_offset() + 5].try_into().unwrap()
372:         ) as usize;
373: 
374:         // Calculate CRC32
375:         let crc32_stored = u32::from_le_bytes(
376:             kv_hdr_buf[kv_name_len_offset() - 4..kv_name_len_offset()].try_into().unwrap()
377:         );
378: 
379:         let mut calc_crc: u32 = 0;
380:         // CRC32(name_len as uint32 + value_len as uint32 + name + value)
381:         let name_len_bytes = (name_len as u32).to_le_bytes();
382:         calc_crc = calc_crc32(calc_crc, &name_len_bytes);
383:         let value_len_bytes = (value_len as u32).to_le_bytes();
384:         calc_crc = calc_crc32(calc_crc, &value_len_bytes);
385: 
386:         let crc_data_len = kv.len as usize - kv_hdr_sz;
387:         let mut buf = [0u8; 32];
388:         let mut len = 0usize;
389:         while len < crc_data_len {
390:             let size = if len + 32 < crc_data_len { 32 } else { crc_data_len - len };
391:             let read_size = wg_align(size);
392:             let mut read_buf = vec![0u8; read_size];
393:             if self.be().read(kv.addr_start + kv_hdr_sz as u32 + len as u32, &mut read_buf).is_err() {
394:                 kv.crc_is_ok = false;
395:                 return Err(FdbErr::ReadErr);
396:             }
397:             calc_crc = calc_crc32(calc_crc, &read_buf[..size]);
398:             len += size;
399:         }
400: 
401:         if calc_crc != crc32_stored {
402:             kv.crc_is_ok = false;
403:             // Try to read name anyway
404:             let actual_name_len = name_len.min(FDB_KV_NAME_MAX);
405:             let aligned_name_len = wg_align(actual_name_len);
406:             let mut name_buf = vec![0u8; aligned_name_len];
407:             let _ = self.be().read(kv.addr_start + kv_hdr_sz as u32, &mut name_buf);
408:             kv.name[..actual_name_len].copy_from_slice(&name_buf[..actual_name_len]);
409:             kv.name_len = actual_name_len as u8;
410:             return Err(FdbErr::ReadErr);
411:         }
412: 
413:         kv.crc_is_ok = true;
414:         kv.name_len = name_len as u8;
415:         kv.value_len = value_len as u32;
416: 
417:         let actual_name_len = name_len.min(FDB_KV_NAME_MAX);
418:         let aligned_name_len = wg_align(actual_name_len);
419:         let mut name_buf = vec![0u8; aligned_name_len];
420:         self.be().read(kv.addr_start + kv_hdr_sz as u32, &mut name_buf)?;
421:         kv.name[..actual_name_len].copy_from_slice(&name_buf[..actual_name_len]);
422:         if actual_name_len < kv.name.len() {
423:             kv.name[actual_name_len] = 0;
424:         }
425: 
426:         kv.addr_value = kv.addr_start + kv_hdr_sz as u32 + wg_align(actual_name_len) as u32;
427: 
428:         Ok(())
429:     }

431:     /// Read sector info from flash.
432:     fn read_sector_info(&mut self, addr: u32, traversal: bool) -> Result<KvdbSecInfo, FdbErr> {
433:         assert_eq!(addr % self.sec_size, 0);
434: 
435:         let sec_hdr_sz = sector_hdr_data_size(self.sec_size);
436: 
437:         // Check cache
438:         if let Some(idx) = self.get_sector_from_cache(addr) {
439:             if !traversal || (traversal && self.sector_cache[idx].empty_kv != FDB_FAILED_ADDR) {
440:                 return Ok(self.sector_cache[idx].clone());
441:             }
442:         }
443: 
444:         let mut sec_hdr_buf = vec![0u8; sec_hdr_sz];
445:         self.be().read(addr, &mut sec_hdr_buf)?;
446: 
447:         let mut sector = KvdbSecInfo::default();
448:         sector.addr = addr;
449: 
450:         // Parse sector header
451:         let store_status = status::get_status(
452:             &sec_hdr_buf[sector_store_offset()..sector_store_offset() + FDB_STORE_STATUS_TABLE_SIZE],
453:             FDB_SECTOR_STORE_STATUS_NUM,
454:         );
455:         sector.store_status = match store_status {
456:             0 => SectorStoreStatus::Unused,
457:             1 => SectorStoreStatus::Empty,
458:             2 => SectorStoreStatus::Using,
459:             3 => SectorStoreStatus::Full,
460:             _ => SectorStoreStatus::Unused,
461:         };
462: 
463:         let dirty_status = status::get_status(
464:             &sec_hdr_buf[sector_dirty_offset()..sector_dirty_offset() + FDB_DIRTY_STATUS_TABLE_SIZE],
465:             FDB_SECTOR_DIRTY_STATUS_NUM,
466:         );
467:         sector.dirty_status = match dirty_status {
468:             0 => SectorDirtyStatus::Unused,
469:             1 => SectorDirtyStatus::False,
470:             2 => SectorDirtyStatus::True,
471:             3 => SectorDirtyStatus::Gc,
472:             _ => SectorDirtyStatus::Unused,
473:         };
474: 
475:         let magic_off = sector_magic_offset();
476:         sector.magic = u32::from_le_bytes(sec_hdr_buf[magic_off..magic_off + 4].try_into().unwrap());
477: 
478:         if sector.magic != KVDB_SECTOR_MAGIC_WORD {
479:             sector.check_ok = false;
480:             sector.combined = SECTOR_NOT_COMBINED;
481:             return Err(FdbErr::InitFailed);
482:         }
483: 
484:         sector.check_ok = true;
485:         let combined_off = magic_off + 4;
486:         sector.combined = u32::from_le_bytes(sec_hdr_buf[combined_off..combined_off + 4].try_into().unwrap());
487: 
488:         if sector.combined != SECTOR_NOT_COMBINED && sector.combined != SECTOR_COMBINED {
489:             sector.check_ok = false;
490:             return Err(FdbErr::InitFailed);
491:         }
492: 
493:         if traversal {
494:             sector.remain = 0;
495:             sector.empty_kv = sector.addr + sec_hdr_sz as u32;
496: 
497:             if sector.store_status == SectorStoreStatus::Empty {
498:                 sector.remain = self.sec_size as usize - sec_hdr_sz;
499:             } else if sector.store_status == SectorStoreStatus::Using {
500:                 sector.remain = self.sec_size as usize - sec_hdr_sz;
501:                 let mut kv_obj = KvInfo::default();
502:                 kv_obj.addr_start = sector.addr + sec_hdr_sz as u32;
503:                 loop {
504:                     let _ = self.read_kv(&mut kv_obj);
505:                     if !kv_obj.crc_is_ok {
506:                         if kv_obj.status != KvStatus::PreWrite && kv_obj.status != KvStatus::ErrHdr {
507:                             sector.remain = 0;
508:                             break;
509:                         }
510:                     }
511:                     sector.empty_kv += kv_obj.len;
512:                     if sector.remain >= kv_obj.len as usize {
513:                         sector.remain -= kv_obj.len as usize;
514:                     } else {
515:                         sector.remain = 0;
516:                     }
517: 
518:                     let next_addr = self.get_next_kv_addr(&sector, &kv_obj);
519:                     if next_addr == FDB_FAILED_ADDR {
520:                         break;
521:                     }
522:                     kv_obj.addr_start = next_addr;
523:                 }
524: 
525:                 // Check continue FF
526:                 let ff_addr = status::continue_ff_addr(
527:                     self.be(),
528:                     sector.empty_kv,
529:                     sector.addr + self.sec_size,
530:                     self.sec_size,
531:                 );
532:                 if sector.empty_kv != ff_addr {
533:                     sector.empty_kv = ff_addr;
534:                     sector.remain = self.sec_size as usize - (ff_addr - sector.addr) as usize;
535:                 }
536:             }
537: 
538:             self.update_sector_cache(&sector);
539:         } else {
540:             if self.get_sector_from_cache(sector.addr).is_none() {
541:                 sector.empty_kv = FDB_FAILED_ADDR;
542:                 sector.remain = 0;
543:                 self.update_sector_cache(&sector);
544:             }
545:         }
546: 
547:         Ok(sector)
548:     }

550:     /// Get next sector address.
551:     fn get_next_sector_addr(&self, pre_sec: &KvdbSecInfo, traversed_len: u32) -> u32 {
552:         let cur_block_size = if pre_sec.combined == SECTOR_NOT_COMBINED {
553:             self.sec_size
554:         } else {
555:             pre_sec.combined * self.sec_size
556:         };
557: 
558:         if traversed_len + cur_block_size <= self.max_size {
559:             if pre_sec.addr + cur_block_size < self.max_size {
560:                 pre_sec.addr + cur_block_size
561:             } else {
562:                 0
563:             }
564:         } else {
565:             FDB_FAILED_ADDR
566:         }
567:     }

569:     /// Format a sector.
570:     fn format_sector(&mut self, addr: u32, combined_value: u32) -> Result<(), FdbErr> {
571:         assert_eq!(addr % self.sec_size, 0);
572: 
573:         self.be().erase(addr, self.sec_size as usize)?;
574: 
575:         let sec_hdr_sz = sector_hdr_data_size(self.sec_size);
576:         let mut sec_hdr_buf = vec![FDB_BYTE_ERASED; sec_hdr_sz];
577: 
578:         // For FDB_WRITE_GRAN=1, build the header in memory then write it all at once
579:         status::set_status(
580:             &mut sec_hdr_buf[sector_store_offset()..sector_store_offset() + FDB_STORE_STATUS_TABLE_SIZE],
581:             FDB_SECTOR_STORE_STATUS_NUM,
582:             SectorStoreStatus::Empty as usize,
583:         );
584:         status::set_status(
585:             &mut sec_hdr_buf[sector_dirty_offset()..sector_dirty_offset() + FDB_DIRTY_STATUS_TABLE_SIZE],
586:             FDB_SECTOR_DIRTY_STATUS_NUM,
587:             SectorDirtyStatus::False as usize,
588:         );
589: 
590:         let magic_off = sector_magic_offset();
591:         sec_hdr_buf[magic_off..magic_off + 4].copy_from_slice(&KVDB_SECTOR_MAGIC_WORD.to_le_bytes());
592:         sec_hdr_buf[magic_off + 4..magic_off + 8].copy_from_slice(&combined_value.to_le_bytes());
593:         sec_hdr_buf[magic_off + 8..magic_off + 12].copy_from_slice(&FDB_DATA_UNUSED.to_le_bytes());
594: 
595:         self.be().write(addr, &sec_hdr_buf, true)?;
596: 
597:         // Invalidate cache
598:         let mut sector = KvdbSecInfo::default();
599:         sector.addr = addr;
600:         sector.check_ok = false;
601:         sector.empty_kv = FDB_FAILED_ADDR;
602:         self.update_sector_cache(&sector);
603: 
604:         Ok(())
605:     }
606: 
607:     /// Update sector status.
608:     fn update_sec_status(&mut self, sector: &mut KvdbSecInfo, new_kv_len: usize) -> Result<bool, FdbErr> {
609:         let mut is_full = false;
610:         let threshold = sec_remain_threshold();
611: 
612:         if sector.store_status == SectorStoreStatus::Empty {
613:             let mut st = vec![0u8; FDB_STORE_STATUS_TABLE_SIZE];
614:             status::write_status(self.be(), sector.addr, &mut st, FDB_SECTOR_STORE_STATUS_NUM, SectorStoreStatus::Using as usize, true)?;
615:             self.update_sector_status_store_cache(sector.addr, SectorStoreStatus::Using);
616:             sector.store_status = SectorStoreStatus::Using;
617:         } else if sector.store_status == SectorStoreStatus::Using {
618:             if sector.remain < threshold || sector.remain - new_kv_len < threshold {
619:                 let mut st = vec![0u8; FDB_STORE_STATUS_TABLE_SIZE];
620:                 status::write_status(self.be(), sector.addr, &mut st, FDB_SECTOR_STORE_STATUS_NUM, SectorStoreStatus::Full as usize, true)?;
621:                 self.update_sector_status_store_cache(sector.addr, SectorStoreStatus::Full);
622:                 sector.store_status = SectorStoreStatus::Full;
623:                 is_full = true;
624:             }
625:         }
626: 
627:         Ok(is_full)
628:     }

630:     /// Find a KV by key.
631:     fn find_kv(&mut self, key: &str) -> Option<KvInfo> {
632:         // Try cache first
633:         if let Some(addr) = self.get_kv_from_cache(key) {
634:             let mut kv = KvInfo::default();
635:             kv.addr_start = addr;
636:             if self.read_kv(&mut kv).is_ok() && kv.crc_is_ok {
637:                 return Some(kv);
638:             }
639:         }
640: 
641:         // Linear scan
642:         let result = self.find_kv_no_cache(key);
643:         if let Some(ref kv) = result {
644:             self.update_kv_cache(key, kv.addr_start);
645:         }
646:         result
647:     }
648: 
649:     fn find_kv_no_cache(&mut self, key: &str) -> Option<KvInfo> {
650:         let mut kv = KvInfo::default();
651:         let mut found = false;
652:         self.kv_iterator(&mut kv, key, &mut found, Self::find_kv_cb);
653:         if found { Some(kv) } else { None }
654:     }
655: 
656:     fn find_kv_cb(kv: &KvInfo, key: &str, found: &mut bool) -> bool {
657:         let key_len = key.len();
658:         if kv.name_len as usize != key_len {
659:             return false;
660:         }
661:         if kv.crc_is_ok && kv.status == KvStatus::Write && &kv.name[..key_len] == key.as_bytes() {
662:             *found = true;
663:             return true;
664:         }
665:         false
666:     }

668:     /// Iterate over all KVs.
669:     fn kv_iterator<F>(&mut self, kv: &mut KvInfo, arg1: &str, arg2: &mut bool, callback: F)
670:     where
671:         F: Fn(&KvInfo, &str, &mut bool) -> bool,
672:     {
673:         let mut sec_addr = self.oldest_addr;
674:         let mut traversed_len = 0u32;
675:         let sec_hdr_sz = sector_hdr_data_size(self.sec_size) as u32;
676: 
677:         loop {
678:             traversed_len += self.sec_size;
679:             let sector = match self.read_sector_info(sec_addr, false) {
680:                 Ok(s) => s,
681:                 Err(_) => {
682:                     let next = self.get_next_sector_addr(&{
683:                         let mut s = KvdbSecInfo::default();
684:                         s.addr = sec_addr;
685:                         s.combined = SECTOR_NOT_COMBINED;
686:                         s
687:                     }, traversed_len);
688:                     if next == FDB_FAILED_ADDR { break; }
689:                     sec_addr = next;
690:                     continue;
691:                 }
692:             };
693: 
694:             if sector.store_status == SectorStoreStatus::Using || sector.store_status == SectorStoreStatus::Full {
695:                 kv.addr_start = sector.addr + sec_hdr_sz;
696:                 loop {
697:                     if self.read_kv(kv).is_err() && !kv.crc_is_ok {
698:                         // Continue scanning
699:                     }
700:                     if callback(kv, arg1, arg2) {
701:                         return;
702:                     }
703:                     let next = self.get_next_kv_addr(&sector, kv);
704:                     if next == FDB_FAILED_ADDR { break; }
705:                     kv.addr_start = next;
706:                 }
707:             }
708: 
709:             let next = self.get_next_sector_addr(&sector, traversed_len);
710:             if next == FDB_FAILED_ADDR { break; }
711:             sec_addr = next;
712:         }
713:     }

715:     /// Sector iterator.
716:     fn sector_iterator<F>(&mut self, status_filter: SectorStoreStatus, traversal: bool, mut callback: F)
717:     where
718:         F: FnMut(&mut Kvdb, &KvdbSecInfo) -> bool,
719:     {
720:         let mut sec_addr = self.oldest_addr;
721:         let mut traversed_len = 0u32;
722: 
723:         loop {
724:             traversed_len += self.sec_size;
725:             let sector = match self.read_sector_info(sec_addr, false) {
726:                 Ok(s) => s,
727:                 Err(_) => {
728:                     let next = self.get_next_sector_addr(&{
729:                         let mut s = KvdbSecInfo::default();
730:                         s.addr = sec_addr;
731:                         s.combined = SECTOR_NOT_COMBINED;
732:                         s
733:                     }, traversed_len);
734:                     if next == FDB_FAILED_ADDR { break; }
735:                     sec_addr = next;
736:                     continue;
737:                 }
738:             };
739: 
740:             if status_filter == SectorStoreStatus::Unused || sector.store_status == status_filter {
741:                 let sector = if traversal {
742:                     match self.read_sector_info(sec_addr, true) {
743:                         Ok(s) => s,
744:                         Err(_) => sector,
745:                     }
746:                 } else {
747:                     sector
748:                 };
749: 
750:                 if callback(self, &sector) {
751:                     return;
752:                 }
753:             }
754: 
755:             let next = self.get_next_sector_addr(&sector, traversed_len);
756:             if next == FDB_FAILED_ADDR { break; }
757:             sec_addr = next;
758:         }
759:     }

761:     /// Allocate a KV in a sector.
762:     fn alloc_kv(&mut self, kv_size: usize) -> (u32, KvdbSecInfo) {
763:         let mut empty_kv = FDB_FAILED_ADDR;
764:         let mut empty_sector = 0usize;
765:         let mut using_sector = 0usize;
766:         let threshold = sec_remain_threshold();
767: 
768:         // Statistics
769:         let mut temp_sector = KvdbSecInfo::default();
770:         let sec_addr_bak = self.oldest_addr;
771:         let mut sec_addr = self.oldest_addr;
772:         let mut traversed_len = 0u32;
773: 
774:         loop {
775:             traversed_len += self.sec_size;
776:             match self.read_sector_info(sec_addr, false) {
777:                 Ok(sector) => {
778:                     if sector.check_ok && sector.store_status == SectorStoreStatus::Empty {
779:                         empty_sector += 1;
780:                     } else if sector.check_ok && sector.store_status == SectorStoreStatus::Using {
781:                         using_sector += 1;
782:                     }
783:                 }
784:                 Err(_) => {}
785:             }
786: 
787:             let next = self.get_next_sector_addr(&{
788:                 let mut s = KvdbSecInfo::default();
789:                 s.addr = sec_addr;
790:                 s.combined = SECTOR_NOT_COMBINED;
791:                 s
792:             }, traversed_len);
793:             if next == FDB_FAILED_ADDR { break; }
794:             sec_addr = next;
795:         }
796: 
797:         // Try using sectors first
798:         if using_sector > 0 {
799:             sec_addr = self.oldest_addr;
800:             traversed_len = 0;
801:             loop {
802:                 traversed_len += self.sec_size;
803:                 let sector = match self.read_sector_info(sec_addr, true) {
804:                     Ok(s) => s,
805:                     Err(_) => {
806:                         let next = self.get_next_sector_addr(&{
807:                             let mut s = KvdbSecInfo::default();
808:                             s.addr = sec_addr;
809:                             s.combined = SECTOR_NOT_COMBINED;
810:                             s
811:                         }, traversed_len);
812:                         if next == FDB_FAILED_ADDR { break; }
813:                         sec_addr = next;
814:                         continue;
815:                     }
816:                 };
817: 
818:                 if sector.check_ok && sector.remain > kv_size + threshold
819:                     && (sector.dirty_status == SectorDirtyStatus::False
820:                         || (sector.dirty_status == SectorDirtyStatus::True && !self.gc_request))
821:                     && sector.store_status == SectorStoreStatus::Using
822:                 {
823:                     empty_kv = sector.empty_kv;
824:                     return (empty_kv, sector);
825:                 }
826: 
827:                 let next = self.get_next_sector_addr(&sector, traversed_len);
828:                 if next == FDB_FAILED_ADDR { break; }
829:                 sec_addr = next;
830:             }
831:         }
832: 
833:         // Try empty sectors
834:         if empty_sector > 0 && empty_kv == FDB_FAILED_ADDR {
835:             if empty_sector > FDB_GC_EMPTY_SEC_THRESHOLD || self.gc_request {
836:                 sec_addr = self.oldest_addr;
837:                 traversed_len = 0;
838:                 loop {
839:                     traversed_len += self.sec_size;
840:                     let sector = match self.read_sector_info(sec_addr, true) {
841:                         Ok(s) => s,
842:                         Err(_) => {
843:                             let next = self.get_next_sector_addr(&{
844:                                 let mut s = KvdbSecInfo::default();
845:                                 s.addr = sec_addr;
846:                                 s.combined = SECTOR_NOT_COMBINED;
847:                                 s
848:                             }, traversed_len);
849:                             if next == FDB_FAILED_ADDR { break; }
850:                             sec_addr = next;
851:                             continue;
852:                         }
853:                     };
854: 
855:                     if sector.check_ok && sector.remain > kv_size + threshold
856:                         && (sector.dirty_status == SectorDirtyStatus::False
857:                             || (sector.dirty_status == SectorDirtyStatus::True && !self.gc_request))
858:                         && sector.store_status == SectorStoreStatus::Empty
859:                     {
860:                         empty_kv = sector.empty_kv;
861:                         return (empty_kv, sector);
862:                     }
863: 
864:                     let next = self.get_next_sector_addr(&sector, traversed_len);
865:                     if next == FDB_FAILED_ADDR { break; }
866:                     sec_addr = next;
867:                 }
868:             } else {
869:                 self.gc_request = true;
870:             }
871:         }
872: 
873:         (empty_kv, KvdbSecInfo::default())
874:     }

876:     /// Delete a KV.
877:     fn del_kv(&mut self, key: Option<&str>, old_kv: &KvInfo, complete_del: bool) -> Result<(), FdbErr> {
878:         let mut result = FdbErr::NoErr;
879: 
880:         if !complete_del {
881:             let mut st = vec![0u8; KV_STATUS_TABLE_SIZE];
882:             result = status::write_status(self.be(), old_kv.addr_start, &mut st, FDB_KV_STATUS_NUM, KvStatus::PreDelete as usize, false);
883:             self.last_is_complete_del = true;
884:         } else {
885:             let mut st = vec![0u8; KV_STATUS_TABLE_SIZE];
886:             result = status::write_status(self.be(), old_kv.addr_start, &mut st, FDB_KV_STATUS_NUM, KvStatus::Deleted as usize, true);
887: 
888:             if !self.last_is_complete_del && result == FdbErr::NoErr {
889:                 if let Some(k) = key {
890:                     self.update_kv_cache(k, FDB_DATA_UNUSED);
891:                 } else {
892:                     let name = std::str::from_utf8(&old_kv.name[..old_kv.name_len as usize]).unwrap_or("");
893:                     self.update_kv_cache(name, FDB_DATA_UNUSED);
894:                 }
895:             }
896:             self.last_is_complete_del = false;
897:         }
898: 
899:         // Update dirty status
900:         if result == FdbErr::NoErr {
901:             let dirty_status_addr = fdb_align_down(old_kv.addr_start as usize, self.sec_size as usize) as u32
902:                 + sector_dirty_offset() as u32;
903:             let mut dirty_st = vec![0u8; FDB_DIRTY_STATUS_TABLE_SIZE];
904:             let current_dirty = status::read_status(self.be(), dirty_status_addr, &mut dirty_st, FDB_SECTOR_DIRTY_STATUS_NUM);
905:             if current_dirty == SectorDirtyStatus::False as usize {
906:                 let mut st = vec![0u8; FDB_DIRTY_STATUS_TABLE_SIZE];
907:                 result = status::write_status(self.be(), dirty_status_addr, &mut st, FDB_SECTOR_DIRTY_STATUS_NUM, SectorDirtyStatus::True as usize, true);
908: 
909:                 let sec_addr = fdb_align_down(old_kv.addr_start as usize, self.sec_size as usize) as u32;
910:                 if let Some(idx) = self.get_sector_from_cache(sec_addr) {
911:                     self.sector_cache[idx].dirty_status = SectorDirtyStatus::True;
912:                 }
913:             }
914:         }
915: 
916:         Ok(result)
917:     }

919:     /// Move a KV to new space.
920:     fn move_kv(&mut self, kv: &KvInfo) -> Result<(), FdbErr> {
921:         if kv.status == KvStatus::Write {
922:             self.del_kv(None, kv, false)?;
923:         }
924: 
925:         let (kv_addr, mut sector) = self.alloc_kv(kv.len as usize);
926:         if kv_addr == FDB_FAILED_ADDR {
927:             return Err(FdbErr::SavedFull);
928:         }
929: 
930:         // Update sector status
931:         self.update_sec_status(&mut sector, kv.len as usize)?;
932: 
933:         // Write KV header (pre-write status)
934:         let mut st = vec![0u8; KV_STATUS_TABLE_SIZE];
935:         status::write_status(self.be(), kv_addr, &mut st, FDB_KV_STATUS_NUM, KvStatus::PreWrite as usize, false)?;
936: 
937:         // Copy data
938:         let kv_hdr_sz = kv_hdr_data_size() as u32;
939:         let magic_off = kv_magic_offset() as u32;
940:         let kv_len = kv.len - magic_off;
941:         let mut buf = [0u8; 32];
942:         let mut len = 0u32;
943:         while len < kv_len {
944:             let size = if len + 32 < kv_len { 32 } else { kv_len - len };
945:             let read_size = wg_align(size as usize);
946:             let mut read_buf = vec![0u8; read_size];
947:             self.be().read(kv.addr_start + magic_off + len, &mut read_buf)?;
948:             self.be().write(kv_addr + magic_off + len, &read_buf[..size as usize], true)?;
949:             len += size as u32;
950:         }
951: 
952:         // Write status to WRITE
953:         let mut st = vec![0u8; KV_STATUS_TABLE_SIZE];
954:         status::write_status(self.be(), kv_addr, &mut st, FDB_KV_STATUS_NUM, KvStatus::Write as usize, true)?;
955: 
956:         // Update caches
957:         self.update_sector_empty_addr_cache(
958:             fdb_align_down(kv_addr as usize, self.sec_size as usize) as u32,
959:             kv_addr + kv_hdr_sz + wg_align(kv.name_len as usize) as u32 + wg_align(kv.value_len as usize) as u32,
960:         );
961:         let name = std::str::from_utf8(&kv.name[..kv.name_len as usize]).unwrap_or("");
962:         self.update_kv_cache(name, kv_addr);
963: 
964:         // Delete old KV
965:         self.del_kv(None, kv, true)?;
966: 
967:         Ok(())
968:     }

970:     /// GC collect by free size.
971:     fn gc_collect_by_free_size(&mut self, free_size: usize) {
972:         let mut empty_sec_num = 0usize;
973:         let mut empty_sec_addr = 0u32;
974: 
975:         // Check empty sector count
976:         let mut sec_addr = self.oldest_addr;
977:         let mut traversed_len = 0u32;
978:         loop {
979:             traversed_len += self.sec_size;
980:             match self.read_sector_info(sec_addr, false) {
981:                 Ok(sector) => {
982:                     if sector.check_ok && sector.store_status == SectorStoreStatus::Empty {
983:                         empty_sec_num += 1;
984:                         empty_sec_addr = sector.addr;
985:                     }
986:                 }
987:                 Err(_) => {}
988:             }
989:             let next = self.get_next_sector_addr(&{
990:                 let mut s = KvdbSecInfo::default();
991:                 s.addr = sec_addr;
992:                 s.combined = SECTOR_NOT_COMBINED;
993:                 s
994:             }, traversed_len);
995:             if next == FDB_FAILED_ADDR { break; }
996:             sec_addr = next;
997:         }
998: 
999:         if empty_sec_num <= FDB_GC_EMPTY_SEC_THRESHOLD {
1000:             // Do GC
1001:             sec_addr = self.oldest_addr;
1002:             traversed_len = 0;
1003:             let mut last_gc_sec_addr = empty_sec_addr;
1004:             loop {
1005:                 traversed_len += self.sec_size;
1006:                 let sector = match self.read_sector_info(sec_addr, false) {
1007:                     Ok(s) => s,
1008:                     Err(_) => {
1009:                         let next = self.get_next_sector_addr(&{
1010:                             let mut s = KvdbSecInfo::default();
1011:                             s.addr = sec_addr;
1012:                             s.combined = SECTOR_NOT_COMBINED;
1013:                             s
1014:                         }, traversed_len);
1015:                         if next == FDB_FAILED_ADDR { break; }
1016:                         sec_addr = next;
1017:                         continue;
1018:                     }
1019:                 };
1020: 
1021:                 if sector.check_ok && (sector.dirty_status == SectorDirtyStatus::True || sector.dirty_status == SectorDirtyStatus::Gc) {
1022:                     // Mark as GC
1023:                     let dirty_addr = sector.addr + sector_dirty_offset() as u32;
1024:                     let mut dirty_st = vec![0u8; FDB_DIRTY_STATUS_TABLE_SIZE];
1025:                     let _ = status::write_status(self.be(), dirty_addr, &mut dirty_st, FDB_SECTOR_DIRTY_STATUS_NUM, SectorDirtyStatus::Gc as usize, true);
1026: 
1027:                     // Move all valid KVs
1028:                     let sec_hdr_sz = sector_hdr_data_size(self.sec_size) as u32;
1029:                     let mut kv_obj = KvInfo::default();
1030:                     kv_obj.addr_start = sector.addr + sec_hdr_sz;
1031:                     loop {
1032:                         let _ = self.read_kv(&mut kv_obj);
1033:                         if kv_obj.crc_is_ok && (kv_obj.status == KvStatus::Write || kv_obj.status == KvStatus::PreDelete) {
1034:                             if self.move_kv(&kv_obj).is_err() {
1035:                                 break;
1036:                             }
1037:                         }
1038:                         let next = self.get_next_kv_addr(&sector, &kv_obj);
1039:                         if next == FDB_FAILED_ADDR { break; }
1040:                         kv_obj.addr_start = next;
1041:                     }
1042: 
1043:                     self.format_sector(sector.addr, SECTOR_NOT_COMBINED)?;
1044:                     let old_last = last_gc_sec_addr;
1045:                     last_gc_sec_addr = sector.addr;
1046: 
1047:                     // Update oldest_addr
1048:                     let next_sec = self.get_next_sector_addr(&sector, 0);
1049:                     self.oldest_addr = next_sec;
1050: 
1051:                     // Check if we have enough space
1052:                     if let Ok(last_gc_sector) = self.read_sector_info(old_last, true) {
1053:                         if last_gc_sector.remain > free_size {
1054:                             break;
1055:                         }
1056:                     }
1057:                 }
1058: 
1059:                 let next = self.get_next_sector_addr(&sector, traversed_len);
1060:                 if next == FDB_FAILED_ADDR { break; }
1061:                 sec_addr = next;
1062:             }
1063:         }
1064: 
1065:         self.gc_request = false;
1066:     }

1068:     /// Create a KV blob.
1069:     fn create_kv_blob(&mut self, sector: &mut KvdbSecInfo, key: &str, value: &[u8]) -> Result<(), FdbErr> {
1070:         let kv_hdr_sz = kv_hdr_data_size();
1071:         let key_len = key.len();
1072:         let value_len = value.len();
1073: 
1074:         if key_len > FDB_KV_NAME_MAX {
1075:             return Err(FdbErr::KvNameErr);
1076:         }
1077: 
1078:         let total_len = kv_hdr_sz + wg_align(key_len) + wg_align(value_len);
1079:         if total_len > self.sec_size as usize - sector_hdr_data_size(self.sec_size) {
1080:             return Err(FdbErr::SavedFull);
1081:         }
1082: 
1083:         let kv_addr = if sector.empty_kv != FDB_FAILED_ADDR {
1084:             sector.empty_kv
1085:         } else {
1086:             let (addr, _) = self.alloc_kv(total_len);
1087:             if addr == FDB_FAILED_ADDR {
1088:                 // Try GC
1089:                 if self.gc_request {
1090:                     self.gc_collect_by_free_size(total_len);
1091:                     let (addr2, _) = self.alloc_kv(total_len);
1092:                     if addr2 == FDB_FAILED_ADDR {
1093:                         return Err(FdbErr::SavedFull);
1094:                     }
1095:                     addr2
1096:                 } else {
1097:                     return Err(FdbErr::SavedFull);
1098:                 }
1099:             } else {
1100:                 addr
1101:             }
1102:         };
1103: 
1104:         let is_full = self.update_sec_status(sector, total_len)?;
1105: 
1106:         // Build KV header
1107:         let mut kv_hdr_buf = vec![FDB_BYTE_ERASED; kv_hdr_sz];

277:         sector.empty_idx = sector.addr + sec_hdr_sz as u32;
278:         sector.empty_data = sector.addr + self.sec_size;
279:         sector.remain = (sector.empty_data - sector.empty_idx) as usize;
280: 
281:         if sector.status == SectorStoreStatus::Using && traversal {
282:             let mut tsl = TslInfo::default();
283:             tsl.addr.index = sector.empty_idx;
284: 
285:             while self.read_tsl(&mut tsl).is_ok() {
286:                 if tsl.status == TslStatus::Unused {
287:                     break;
288:                 }
289:                 if tsl.status != TslStatus::PreWrite {
290:                     sector.end_time = tsl.time;
291:                 }
292:                 sector.end_idx = tsl.addr.index;
293:                 sector.empty_idx += log_idx_data_size() as u32;
294:                 sector.empty_data -= wg_align(tsl.log_len as usize) as u32;
295:                 let consumed = log_idx_data_size() + wg_align(tsl.log_len as usize);
296:                 if sector.remain > consumed {
297:                     sector.remain -= consumed;
298:                 } else {
299:                     sector.remain = 0;
300:                     break;
301:                 }
302:                 tsl.addr.index += log_idx_data_size() as u32;
303:             }
304:         }
305: 
306:         Ok(sector)
307:     }

309:     /// Format a sector.
310:     fn format_sector(&mut self, addr: u32) -> Result<(), FdbErr> {
311:         assert_eq!(addr % self.sec_size, 0);
312: 
313:         self.be().erase(addr, self.sec_size as usize)?;
314: 
315:         let mut st = vec![0u8; FDB_STORE_STATUS_TABLE_SIZE];
316:         status::write_status(self.be(), addr, &mut st, FDB_SECTOR_STORE_STATUS_NUM, SectorStoreStatus::Empty as usize, true)?;
317: 
318:         // Write magic
319:         let mut magic_buf = vec![FDB_BYTE_ERASED; wg_align(4)];
320:         magic_buf[..4].copy_from_slice(&TSDB_SECTOR_MAGIC_WORD.to_le_bytes());
321:         self.be().write(addr + sector_magic_offset() as u32, &magic_buf, true)?;
322: 
323:         Ok(())
324:     }

326:     /// Sector iterator.
327:     fn sector_iterator<F>(&mut self, start_addr: u32, status_filter: SectorStoreStatus, traversal: bool, get_next: fn(&Tsdb, &TsdbSecInfo, u32) -> u32, mut callback: F)
328:     where
329:         F: FnMut(&TsdbSecInfo) -> bool,
330:     {
331:         let mut sec_addr = start_addr;
332:         let mut traversed_len = 0u32;
333: 
334:         loop {
335:             traversed_len += self.sec_size;
336:             match self.read_sector_info(sec_addr, false) {
337:                 Ok(sector) => {
338:                     if status_filter == SectorStoreStatus::Unused || sector.status == status_filter {
339:                         let sector = if traversal {
340:                             self.read_sector_info(sec_addr, true).unwrap_or(sector)
341:                         } else {
342:                             sector
343:                         };
344:                         if callback(&sector) {
345:                             return;
346:                         }
347:                     }
348:                 }
349:                 Err(_) => {}
350:             }
351: 
352:             let next = {
353:                 let mut s = TsdbSecInfo::default();
354:                 s.addr = sec_addr;
355:                 s
356:             };
357:             let n = get_next(self, &next, traversed_len);
358:             if n == FDB_FAILED_ADDR { break; }
359:             sec_addr = n;
360:         }
361:     }
